## Release-gate verdict — PR #769

Recorded by the outer loop on behalf of the fresh-context gate dispatch (Amendment 37), 2026-09-12. This is the outer loop's own PR; the gate was dispatched for that reason and its one required change has been applied and re-verified.

**What the gate confirmed about the change as submitted:** YAML parses; `${GITHUB_SHA}` is shell-expanded on `push` and is the squash commit on `main` (the same variable already tags the zot push); the Dockerfile's `ARG`/`ENV GIT_SHA` sits below `apt-get` and `uv pip install` on `main`, so the per-commit value invalidates only `ENV`/`EXPOSE`/`CMD`; `openapi_app.py:144` returns the env var; #766 is an ancestor of `main` and `parents[4]` survives only as a comment, so the build this triggers will not trip #756's smoke test.

**F3 (MEDIUM) — upheld and fixed (commit `907df77`).** The build-arg was wired but nothing proved it took. #766 shipped `git_sha` as an observable no check consumed and it stayed `unknown` until a gate noticed; a misquoted variable or renamed `ARG` would ship the same inert value again with only a human `kubectl exec` to find it. The build-host smoke test now fetches `/health` and **fails the build unless `git_sha` equals the pushed commit exactly.** Corroboration the gate offered and I accept: OPS-109's discarded attempt-1 patch wrote the same assertion independently.

**Post-merge proof, per the gate — inspect the pod, not the rollout.** `M=$(gh pr view 769 --json mergeCommit -q .mergeCommit.oid)`; a `build-mcp-hub` run with `headSha == $M` succeeding (which, with the new assertion, already proves the image); then in both `platform-mcp-prod` and `platform-mcp`: `/health` inside the pod returns `git_sha` equal to `$M` — 40 characters, not a prefix, not `unknown`; `printenv GIT_SHA` in `deploy/temporal-worker` equals `$M`; pod `startTime` later than the run; `ls /app/src/tools/ | grep -cE '^(factory_status|incidents)\.py$'` prints `2`. Baseline before merge: both pods 28 min old returning `"git_sha":"unknown"`. `rollout status`, `Available`, `1/1` and restart counts are not evidence of anything — all were true throughout the nine-day regression.

**Ordering:** none with #770/#771. **#769 must land before OPS-109 (`83cafa82`) is dispatched again**, so the worker's clone already carries the build-arg — the gate's condition, now moot for attempt 2 (in review as #772) but binding on any retry.

Release-gate: MERGE-WITH-CHANGES
